title: Combine Multiple PDF Files
h1: Combine Multiple PDF Files Online (Free & Client-Side)
description: Merge and combine multiple PDF files into one single document. Instant local processing, 100% private, no limit.

sections.title: Combine Multiple PDF Files into One
sections.content: Organize your workflow by merging invoices, reports, or chapters into a single PDF file instantly. No upload required.

steps.title: Upload Files
steps.description: Drag and drop all the PDFs you want to merge.

steps.title: Reorder Pages
steps.description: Drag to rearrange the order of the documents as you see fit.

steps.title: Merge & Download
steps.description: Click merge and download your combined PDF immediately.

sections.title: Combine Dozens of Files Securely
sections.content: Because we process everything in your browser, you can merge gigabytes of PDFs without waiting for slow internet uploads.
sections.subTitle: Zero Server Uploads
sections.subContent: All merging is done using your computer's RAM.

sections.title: Keep Your Invoices & Reports Organized
sections.content: Whether you are a student submitting assignments or a freelancer sending invoices, merging them into one file makes it much cleaner.

faqs.q: Is there a limit to how many files I can combine?
faqs.a: No. Since it's processed on your device, the only limit is your computer's memory.
Yes, you can easily drag and drop the files into your desired order before merging.

faqs.q: Do my files go to a server?
faqs.a: Absolutely not. The merging happens 100% offline within your browser.
